result = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .circle(1.25)
    .extrude(shank_length)
    .faces(">Z").workplane()
    .circle(head_radius)
    .extrude(1.5)
    .cut(
        cq.Workplane("XY")
            .transformed(offset=cq.Vector(0, 0, shank_length + 1.2), rotate=cq.Vector(0, 0, 0))
            .box(5.4, 0.6, 1.4)
    )
)
show_object(result)

    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .cylinder(9.1, 9.4)
    .union(
        cq.Workplane("XY")
            .transformed(offset=cq.Vector(25.35, 0, 0), rotate=cq.Vector(0, 0, 0))
            .box(32.9, 9.1, 5.6)
    )
    .union(
        cq.Workplane("XY")
            .transformed(offset=cq.Vector(46.7, 0, 0.0), rotate=cq.Vector(0, 0, 0))
            .cylinder(9.1, 5.4)
    )
    .faces(">Z").workplane()
    .hole(10.8)
    .cut(
        cq.Workplane("XY")
            .transformed(offset=cq.Vector(46.7, 0, 0.0), rotate=cq.Vector(0, 0, 0))
            .cylinder(13.65, 2.6)
    )
)
result = result.clean()
show_object(result)
